name: Kaunas University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences college in Kaunas with seven English-taught professional bachelor's in business, tourism, computing and nursing.

ib.text: Upload your IB diploma and results (50% average minimum); English needs IELTS 5.5 or equivalent, or the college's B2 test; a school letter on the language of instruction is not accepted. A test and interview follow.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Trains international business managers to analyse the business environment, work with foreign partners and customers, and plan international activities in a company or department.
programmes.overview: You start with economics, business mathematics and intercultural communication, then move through entrepreneurship, AI and innovation, management, marketing, enterprise and human resource management, international trade, supply chains and international negotiation. A professional internship and a business process simulation come in year two, and every student spends a semester at a partner university or in a foreign company. You choose one of two specialisations, E-Business or International Marketing, and a double degree with Thomas More in Belgium is possible. Studies run in stages rather than one big exam period. A final internship and project close the degree, and placements have included Teltonika Networks, Pigu and Hostinger.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required; a knowledge and skills test and motivation interview apply.

programmes.name: Sales and Marketing
programmes.about: Professional bachelor in sales and marketing with a key competence test and motivation interview for entry.
programmes.overview: The first year covers economics, business English, communication psychology and negotiation, then marketing, management, accounting, business models and creativity methods. Later modules cover brand and consumer experience, market research, trade management, supply chains and data analytics and pricing. A simulation and a professional internship in a company come in year two, and the last semester is a final internship and project. In year three you pick digital marketing communication with e-business or sales in B2B and B2C markets. Exchange semesters or placements are possible in countries such as Spain, Portugal, Germany and Finland. Graduates work as brand managers, sales managers and marketing specialists, or start businesses.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism and Hotel Management
programmes.about: Three-year programme for people passionate about tourism, with international exchanges and hands-on experience; delivered in Lithuania for more than 20 years.
programmes.overview: After a first year of economics, tourism services and resources, travel geography, intercultural communication and tourism anthropology, you study management, marketing, accounting, business law and sustainable tourism business. Practice is a large part of the programme: a professional internship in a business enterprise in the second, fourth and sixth semesters, plus educational visits to hotels and attractions. In year three you choose either Tourism Management or Hotel Management. A double degree with LAB University of Applied Sciences in Finland is available. Graduates work in hotels, travel agencies, tourist information centres and wellness or leisure businesses.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required.

programmes.name: English for Public Relations
programmes.about: Specialists who communicate in professional English, use management and public-communication terms, run internal and external communication and develop information products.
programmes.overview: Alongside intensive English (grammar, phonetics, lexicology, stylistics, business English up to a professional level) you study social psychology, intercultural communication, organisational communication, sociolinguistics and public relations, plus a second foreign language from German, French, Russian, Spanish or Italian. Teaching is task-based and group-based. Internships in media outlets, cultural and social service centres and private companies run through three semesters, and the degree ends with content localisation and a final thesis. Short study or placement periods are possible in Portugal, Spain, Belgium, Turkey, Ireland and Latvia, and a double degree with the University of Tirana is offered.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required.

programmes.name: Multimedia Technology
programmes.about: Specialists who assess the market for multimedia products, design and justify new product concepts, and develop multimedia products and systems.
programmes.overview: Early semesters mix mathematics, graphic design, computer graphics, electronics, cybersecurity and programming. Later you add video and audio technology, electronic publishing, 2D animation, 3D modelling and animation, media communication and media business management. Practical training is central, with two multimedia product design courses run as internships, a final internship and a thesis. The profile leans toward digital content, interface design and interactive media. Graduates work as digital content creators, UI and UX designers, animation and 3D designers or virtual and augmented reality developers in agencies, start-ups, game studios and TV.

programmes.name: Software systems
programmes.about: Professionals who design, develop and install client/server, data engineering and internet-of-things software systems and solve software tasks in organisations.
programmes.overview: The degree builds from Java, Python, C#, algorithms, databases, web design and networks into .NET, software testing, mobile programming, cloud computing and cyber security. A course project each semester takes you from a single-user system to client-server and heterogeneous systems, a long programming practice follows in year three, and a final internship and thesis finish the degree. In the sixth semester you choose between a machine learning engineering route and an internet-of-things route. Graduates work as software designers and analysts, programmers, testers and project managers, and can continue to a master's in informatics in Lithuania or abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: General Practice Nursing
programmes.about: Trains general practice nurses for care across settings and all ages, including healthy lifestyle support and evidence-based practice.
programmes.overview: Seven semesters combine anatomy, physiology, pharmacology and microbiology with general, surgical, therapeutic, geriatric, mental health, emergency and intensive, children's, maternity, palliative and community nursing. Much of the time is clinical: simulation classes with mannequins and acted situations, then professional internships in primary care centres and in second- and third-level hospital departments. Study or placement periods abroad are possible through Erasmus+, and a double diploma with XAMK in Finland is offered. A final internship and thesis close the degree. Graduates work as nurses in hospitals, clinics, doctors' and nurses' practices and community settings.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Documents may be in English or Lithuanian; key competence test and motivation interview apply.

notes: EU citizens can apply for a state-funded place through the national LAMA BPO joint admission; otherwise the college's own route applies, with a €120 application fee and the same fees for every nationality.

The 2026 list also showed Fashion Design, Oral Hygiene, Photography and Organization Management (Alytus) as English programmes not accepting applications, so they are left out until the college lists them.
Fees are fixed in the study agreement and paid for the whole first year in advance; 2026 prices are €2,750, €3,100, €3,510 and €4,680 depending on the programme.
